deliverable.source_excerpt: # Supreme Platform Quality Architecture This document defines the engineering contract for the Shirmani Research Institute platform. ## Core objective Build a fast, reproducible, evidence-aware platform in which AI agents, ML/NLP pipelines, Automission, research, publishing, livelihood surfaces and repository federation remain observable and separately verifiable. ## Intelligence stack Observation → ingestion → normalization → retrieval → semantic/NLP analysis → reasoning → evidence mapping → verification → QC → publication/archive. Multimodal research may accept text, speech, image/video and instrument/sensor data. A signal is never silently converted into a claim about subjective experience; the system reports observable patterns, interpretation, uncertainty and evidence state. ## Agent layers Source Librarian → Dedup/Canonicalization → Concept Mapper → Research → Evidence → Verification → Language → Audio → Publishing → SEO → Archive. Additional specialist layers may include ML/NLP, coding, security, business/livelihood and federation supervision. ## Automission contract Observe → Queue → Execute → Verify → Audit → Persist → Resume. Five-minute scheduling is a trigger, not proof of continuous execution. Durable artifacts and GitHub Actions evidence determine actual state. ## Accuracy contract No system component may manufacture accuracy, verification, scientific proof, model
